name: Swara Baby Products
summary: Swara Baby Products, backed by FirstCry parent Brainbees Solutions, is a contract manufacturer of disposable hygiene products such as baby diapers, based in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh. Revenue grew from ₹767 cr in FY24 to ₹1,212 cr in FY26, and profit rose 18.5% in FY26 to ₹95.6 cr, though the net margin is down from about 12% in FY24 to about 8%. Borrowings grew faster than revenue to ₹443 cr, with debt to equity at 0.81; about ₹128 cr of the ₹500 cr fresh issue goes to repaying debt and about ₹198 cr to a new project. The RHP cut the issue to ₹800 cr with a ₹300 cr offer for sale, and the price band was not yet announced when this was written, so valuation checks are not available.
